description: Sending the new first point to zero and n to n+1 bijects the ordered sum of one point and the naturals with the usual natural-number order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.firstPointEnumeration_order_iso :
  Function.Bijective Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.firstPointEnumeration ∧
    ∀ (x y : Unit ⊕ ℕ),
      Sum.Lex emptyRelation (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) x y ↔
        Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.firstPointEnumeration x <
          Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.firstPointEnumeration y
